import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import root

n=150000
logf=np.log(n)-10.0          # target entropy
meanlogf=-np.log(n)-10.0     # target mean log p
m=7
s=np.arange(m,dtype=float)

def make(x):
    c, logt = x
    z=c*s
    z-=z.max()
    q=np.exp(z); q/=q.sum()
    t=np.exp(logt)
    a=1.0-(n-m)*t
    p=np.empty(n)
    p[:m]=a*q
    p[m:]=t
    return p

def fun(x):
    p=make(x)
    if np.any(p<=0) or not np.all(np.isfinite(p)):
        return np.array([1e6,1e6])
    H=-(p*np.log(p)).sum()
    ml=np.log(p).mean()
    return np.array([H-logf, ml-meanlogf])

for x0 in ([0.0, meanlogf], [1.0, meanlogf], [-1.0, meanlogf], [5.0, meanlogf]):
    sol=root(fun,x0,method='hybr')
    print('x0',x0,'success',sol.success,'x',sol.x,'f',fun(sol.x))

import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import root


def build_distribution(n=150_000, target_kl=10.0, head_size=7):
    log_n = np.log(n)
    target_entropy = log_n - target_kl
    target_mean_log = -log_n - target_kl
    scores = np.arange(head_size, dtype=np.float64)

    def distribution(params):
        slope, log_tail = params
        z = slope * scores
        z -= z.max()
        weights = np.exp(z)
        weights /= weights.sum()

        tail = np.exp(log_tail)
        head_mass = 1.0 - (n - head_size) * tail

        p = np.empty(n, dtype=np.float64)
        p[:head_size] = head_mass * weights
        p[head_size:] = tail
        return p

    def equations(params):
        p = distribution(params)
        entropy = -np.sum(p * np.log(p))
        mean_log = np.mean(np.log(p))
        return np.array([entropy - target_entropy, mean_log - target_mean_log])

    guess = np.array([1.0, target_mean_log])
    solution = root(equations, guess, method="hybr")

    if not solution.success:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Solver failed: {solution.message}")

    return distribution(solution.x)


def main():
    n = 150_000
    target_kl = 10.0

    p = build_distribution(n=n, target_kl=target_kl)
    p = p / p.sum()
    p = np.asarray(p, dtype=np.float64)

    uniform = np.full(n, 1.0 / n, dtype=np.float64)
    forward_kl = np.sum(p * np.log(p / uniform))
    backward_kl = np.sum(uniform * np.log(uniform / p))

    assert np.all(np.isfinite(p))
    assert np.all(p >= 0.0)
    assert abs(p.sum() - 1.0) < 1e-12
    assert abs(forward_kl - target_kl) <= 1e-3
    assert abs(backward_kl - target_kl) <= 1e-3

    np.save("/app/dist.npy", p)

    print(f"forward KL:  {forward_kl:.12f}")
    print(f"backward KL: {backward_kl:.12f}")
    print(f"saved {p.shape[0]} probabilities to /app/dist.npy")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
